svg.desc: TÜBİTAK 1001: Tilt-trirotor VTOL controller with task-oriented transfer and rapid adaptation: meta-learning-based reinforcement learning, validated in the hardware loop and in flight. Principal investigator. TÜBİTAK 3501: HJB-regularised soft actor-critic flight control for fixed-wing UAVs with UKF-based online estimation of cable-actuator parameters. Principal investigator.
